messages:
infra-alert-bot: 🔔 ALERT: GPU queue for `gpu-pool-prod` > 1200 msgs. Autoscaler attempts failing (cloud API 403/quota). Paging @Maria H (on-call).
Maria H: ack. looking now. queue growth started ~10:03 UTC? sending initial triage.
Ken T: seeing node flaps in monitoring — a bunch of driver restarts on gpunode-*-17..20. possible Xid churn. can someone pull kernel logs?
Dmitri V: autoscaler logs show repeated `403 QuotaExceeded` from provider for `accelerator-instances`. scale-up requests queued and then dropped.
Maria H: running quick checks — `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending | wc -l` -> 1180 pending on gpu pool.
Maria H: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-prod -o wide` -> several nodes NotReady, some flapping between Ready/NotReady.
Ken T: paste of dmesg snippet from gpunode-17:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (79, 0) at 0x1234abcd
[ 12345.679000] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12346.000000] oom-killer: killing process 9876 (python) score 153 or sacrifice child
[ 12346.000100] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 9876 (python) total-vm:204800kB
```
Ken T: +1 driver/runtime OOM + Xid. This reduces effective capacity even if cloud counts nodes.
SRE-Lead: escalate to P1. impact: host-level flapping reducing GPU capacity -> request backlog -> client 429s. @Customer Success please capture customer-facing impact.
Customer Success: several Dedicated customers reporting increased 429s and latency spikes; tokenized error rate up ~8% for embeddings. We have one SE on call for enterprise customer ACME.
Dmitri V: autoscaler retries were hitting provider rate limits. Also noticed our scale policy sends many concurrent create requests causing API throttling. We need immediate mitigation: 1) reduce demand on GPUs by pausing low-priority jobs 2) force-drain flapping nodes 3) fall back to smaller model variants for high-QPS routes.
Maria H: starting a controlled cordon/drain of NotReady/flapping nodes: `kubectl cordon gpunode-17 && kubectl drain gpunode-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference`
Maria H: drain outputs: `pod/my-inference-job-123 evicted`, `pod/emb-service-45 rescheduled` etc.
deploy-bot: Driver rollout `driver-5.3.0` -> `driver-5.2.1` rollback initiated by Maria H (manual). Canary of 3 nodes.
Ken T: reason for rollback: telemetry shows driver 5.3.0 correlated with Xid spike starting 06:45 UTC. rollback is approved.
SRE-Lead: Also reduce autoscaler concurrency: temporarily set `maxParallelProvision=2` and add exponential backoff. Dmitri can you apply?
Dmitri V: applying patched config now -> `kubectl apply -f autoscaler-patch.yaml` (changed maxParallelProvision from 10 -> 2, added 30s base backoff).
Dmitri V: autoscaler logs after patch: `scaleUp request queued, retrying after 32s` -> requests now spaced.
Eng Platform: opening cloud quota increase request w/ provider and requesting emergency quota bump for accelerators. Ticket #CLD-7421. ETA unknown.
Maria H: beginning to evict spot/low-priority workloads from gpu-pool-prod to free capacity: `kubectl label pod ... priority=low` then `kubectl delete pods -l priority=low -n inference`
Customer Success: update: ACME seeing 429 -> decreased to baseline for some routes after evictions, still elevated for heavy embedding jobs.
Ken T: logs show driver rollback succeeding on canary nodes; waiting on health checks. If canary looks good, we roll the rest.
Maria H: canary health OK after 6m, proceeding to rollout remaining flapping nodes.
infra-alert-bot: EVENT: queue length decreased from 1250 -> 320 over 14m.
Dmitri V: autoscaler accepted new nodes but fewer because some requested creates still delayed by provider. But effective capacity improved due to driver rollback and evictions.
SRE-Lead: please post customer impact summary to incident channel and start a SevPost with timeline. Who's owning postmortem? @Ken T and @Maria H pair with Eng Platform.
Ken T: owning postmortem for driver regression + autoscaler hardening. action items: collect dmesg kernels from flapped nodes, preserve node images, test driver 5.3 in staging with stress harness.
Maria H: follow-up immediate items I applied: cordon/drain 6 nodes, evicted low-priority workloads (~420 pods), rollback driver on 12 nodes, patched autoscaler config.
Eng Platform: will request provider quota bump and add rate-limit-aware batching in autoscaler. Also propose pre-warming reserved instances for peak windows.
Customer Success: I'll send an incident note to affected customers with ETA and mitigation summary.
SRE-Lead: nice mitigation work. keeping P1 until metrics stable for 2 hours. moving to on-call handoff in 1h to EU night shift.
Maria H: handing off to EU on-call @Ken T in 1h. leaving runbook notes in incident doc.
Ken T: acknowledged handoff. continuing monitoring. will reopen if Xid/OOM count increases. :eyes:
infra-alert-bot: REMINDER: attach preserved logs and pod manifests to incident ticket before closing.
SRE-Lead: post-incident next steps: 1) add Xid/OOM alert, 2) autoscaler backoff + concurrency change permanent, 3) driver rollout gating with Xid regression test, 4) customer-facing postmortem.
Maria H: adding those to the ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
